title: What Is Appendix Surgery (Appendectomy)?
description: What appendix surgery (appendectomy) is, what it is for and when it is indicated. Care in Lima with price alternatives.
tldr: Appendix surgery (appendectomy) removes the inflamed appendix and is usually an emergency for appendicitis. The specialist decides the indication; results vary from person to person.
bodyHtml:
Appendix surgery (appendectomy) removes the inflamed appendix and is usually an emergency for appendicitis.

How is it performed?

It is performed laparoscopically or as open surgery; the laparoscopic approach is common because of its recovery.

When is it indicated?

Patients with acute appendicitis. It is an emergency indication that the surgeon confirms.

At Cirugía 24 Horas

We operate in Lima with the same team at different clinics, so you can choose the price alternative that fits you. We also care for patients from abroad.

bodyHtml:

Possible complications
